evidence_quote: Food-Tuesday: 9:30-11:30AM/1-3PM, Every other Wednesday: 5-7:30 PM, Thursday: 9:30-11:30 AM/ 1-3 PM, Every other Friday: 9:30-11:30AM
reason: The Wednesday evening and Friday sessions happen only every other week, but the site shows them every week, so families could show up on a week with no distribution. An alternating-week schedule can't be written as a week_of_month value, so the corrected schedule keeps only the weekly Tue/Thu sessions. The every-other-Wednesday and every-other-Friday sessions should go in the description as text. Distribution is also by appointment only.
verify_note: The quote is in record 728's raw_hours_text. It also appears word for word in the Manassas Park PDF (page 2, SERVE entry, updated 10/2025): 'Every other Wednesday: 5-7:30 PM' and 'Every other Friday: 9:30-11:30AM'. Showing those two sessions every week is wrong half the time. week_of_month cannot express an every-other-week pattern (1st/3rd is not the same thing). The new_hours are correct: Tue=1 and Thu=3, 09:30-11:30 and 13:00-15:00, kind distribution, every week. The Wed and Fri sessions are dropped from structured hours, so applying this fix must also add the every-other-Wednesday 17:00-19:30 and every-other-Friday 09:30-11:30 sessions to the description text, as the reason says. Otherwise the only evening slot is lost entirely. Appointment is already captured as eligibility.appointment=required.

evidence_quote: Food assistance is provided by appointment only. To schedule an appointment, please call 571.748.2680
reason: SERVE's food assistance is by appointment only, so appointment_distribution should be added. pantry_pickup stays, because the vocabulary defines it as a general pantry pickup, not walk-in (walk-in is walk_up), and SERVE still runs a pantry; appointment is also recorded in eligibility.
verify_note: The quote is in record 588's raw_eligibility_text and is confirmed live on pwspca.org/food/. Adding appointment_distribution ('Distribution by appointment') is supported, and it is a food service type, so it fits the food-only categorization rule. Removing pantry_pickup is not supported. In backend/app/vocab.py, pantry_pickup means a general 'Food pantry pickup' in the pantry group, not walk-in; walk-in is the separate walk_up code. SERVE still hands out pantry food for pickup, just by appointment, and both codes map to the same 'pantry' filter group. The corrected finding keeps pantry_pickup and only adds appointment_distribution.
